files.text: This is the Quarantine Authority, valley office Marrow. The valleys of Marrow Creek, Kettle Pass and Cinder Works are closed. The closure is for three days. Residents of Marrow Creek: buses leave the bus depot at six o'clock on the fourteenth of October. Residents of Kettle Pass: the train and the lorries leave over the pass on the fifteenth. Residents of Cinder Works: transport leaves on the fifteenth. Take your documents and one bag each. Do not take animals. Leave your doors unlocked. This message repeats.
